narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative promotion for Emma Mattress. It uses a comedic premise—living in a tent to avoid high housing prices—to highlight the importance of sleep quality and how the brand's mattress can transform even a tent into a high-end bedroom. It concludes with specific promotional codes and social proof to drive sales.
